sections.description: Visual Designer Manager V3 med V1 som funktionel og visuel reference.
sections.changelog: 3.0.0-alpha.20: Menu CRUD + live Header menu parity + nested mobile ancestor edge hardening. VDM can create/delete classic WordPress menus, stale Header menu IDs resolve safely at render time, desktop Header navigation gets an explicit visibility contract, and major mobile bands clear inherited horizontal wrapper padding.
